learned: All governed sections and groups pass on exact final inputs. Runtime, provider, environment, extension, transactions, coverage, and integrity are healthy; the only certification-readiness blocker is the authorized repair tree being uncommitted.

evidence.claim: Repository engineering contract requires clean-tree readiness before the single owned certification profile.
